name: C00/C07 PRD readiness rubric
purpose: Score whether the PRD is complete enough for expert handoff, without confusing AI draft text with human-approved decisions.

field_states.drafted: AI proposed text exists but user approval is pending.
field_states.external-needed: A named external expert/team must provide or confirm content.
field_states.blocked: A required decision/artifact is absent and cannot be bypassed.
field_states.accepted-risk: The user explicitly approved proceeding with a documented gap.

document_gates.description: The PRD states product purpose, target user/customer, business objective, measurable success, scope, and approval owner.
The PRD provides enough system, mechanical, electrical, software, and assumption context for downstream technical teams to start.
The PRD records milestone, schedule, responsibility, review, vendor, and escalation information.
When RF/wireless/cellular/BLE/Wi-Fi/antenna/compliance scope is present, RF requirements are explicit enough for RF review and certification planning.

ready_when: dimensions_or_enclosure_constraints are answered or accepted-risk
user-facing connectors/display/camera/mic/buttons/LEDs are answered or explicitly not applicable
assembly/environment constraints are answered or external-needed with owner
ID/ME owner or vendor is identified
compute/power/interfaces/memory/connectivity/sensors are answered or explicitly not applicable
key parts or reference designs are listed or marked external-needed
compliance and power constraints are answered or accepted-risk
blocked electrical decisions are absent
functional behaviors and operating modes are answered
firmware/application/cloud/manufacturing responsibility split is answered or drafted for approval
state/interface expectations are at least drafted
C03 pin-map dependency is recorded
acceptance criteria are answered or drafted for approval
verification/certification targets are answered or external-needed
EVT/DVT/POC milestone intent is answered
risks and accepted gaps are explicit
cost / price-band target is recorded as a TARGET (never an achievement) or accepted-risk
build quantity / volume ramp intent is recorded or accepted-risk
certification targets (FCC/CE/NCC/...) are recorded as external-lab TARGETS or explicitly N/A
fields carrying these targets are tagged handoff_targets:["C07"] so C07 can pull them
downstream_handoff_gates.description: C07 reads cost/quantity/certification TARGETS from C00; it never authors them fresh. Targets-not-results honesty rule applies.

scoring_policy.rule: A section is ready only when all required fields are complete or partial with an owner; a downstream handoff is ready only when its gate has no blocking states.
